name: For Sale
summary: A two-phase real-estate auction game where players buy properties cheap then sell them for the best cheques.
rules_text: Shuffle 30 property cards (1-30) and 30 currency cards (0k-15k, no 1k, two of each) separately. Give each player coins: 18k for 3-4 players, 14k for 5-6. Remove 6 of each deck with 3 players, 2 with 4. Phase 1: Reveal N properties where N=player count. Starting with last winner, players clockwise either raise the current bid or pass. Passing player takes the lowest remaining property and refunds half his bid rounded down, rest to bank. Last player takes highest property and pays full bid. Winner of highest starts next auction. Repeat until property deck empty; keep leftover coins. Phase 2: Reveal N currency cards. Each player simultaneously plays one owned property face down. Highest property takes highest currency, second takes second, etc. Discard properties. Repeat until all sold. Sum currency plus leftover coins; most money wins, tie break most coins.
rating_reason: Two-phase bidding and bluffing property game fits numeric bids and hidden values
